## Summary

Launch tweet for **RR Pro going public**: Nik's personal L/S strategy, sold as the paid tier on his Substack (https://cointradernik1.substack.com/, verified live at capture — "hundreds of subscribers"). Tweet text: "My personal L/S vs the 100% free Regime Rotation strategy vs buy-and-hold SPY — RR Pro is now available publicly (but just utilise the free strategy if you want simplicity and are looking for a way to beat the benchmark with less vol - and donate to cat and dog shelters when you're in the green pls)."

**Internal consistency check (this capture):** final equity ÷ CAGR converges on the same **~9.1-year window** across all three columns (36.14x @ 48.48%, 7.08x @ 24.07%, 2.85x @ 12.24%) → backtest ≈ mid-2017 → Sep 2026. The OCR'd numbers cohere.

## Verification status
**Top tier for a tweet-sourced strategy — verified at capture:**
- **Named author** with track-record surface (112k followers, macromarketmodel.com dashboards), not an anonymous card.
- **Publication verified live:** cointradernik1.substack.com returns 200, titled "Regime Rotation", tagline "a 100% free macro regime-conditioned ETF strategy", with the free tier exactly as the tweet positions it.
- **Overfitting honesty signals:** IS→OOS Sharpe retention disclosed for both strategies (89.8% / 79.7%) — most tweet backtests never show the out-of-sample decay. Full risk spectrums (Ulcer/Martin, VaR/CVaR, skew/kurtosis, DD recovery) published, including the unflattering bits.
- **Caveats:** self-reported backtest (not third-party audited); RR Pro's 48.5% CAGR / 2.02 Sharpe is exceptional-for-public and is the *marketing* tier — rules are behind the paywall, so treat RR Pro stats as unreplicable until read. Free-tier rules are the verifiable surface.

## Why it matters
- **Completes the TAA evidence triad** in the vault: anonymous AI card (verification failed, [[2026-09-09-l1vsun-yield-curve-aware-momentum]]) ↔ named vendor screen ([[2026-09-09-p123-five-etf-rotation]]) ↔ named independent practitioner with free full rules (this note). Three calibration points for the same strategy family.
- **The calibration lesson:** the free RR's *real* stats (1.84 Sharpe / 24.1% CAGR / −12.8% MaxDD) are almost identical to what the fake l1vsun card *claimed* (1.87 / 18.4% / −9.2%). Headline magnitude does not separate real from fake — disclosure does (named author, live publication, IS→OOS split, free replication path).
- **Actionable:** free tier is the candidate to actually replicate — regime-conditioned ETF rotation with 12.1% vol and −12.8% MaxDD would be a strong simple-TAA baseline; compare on the same window against the P123 five-ETF rotation and 60/40. Inbox task filed.
- **Free-vs-paid framing is itself the lesson:** Nik explicitly tells followers the free strategy is enough ("utilise the free strategy if you want simplicity") — a credible-monetary-incentive tell that rarely accompanies engagement-bait strategy posts.
- **Isolation note (CoS convention):** personal second-brain knowledge capture only; nothing routed to the trading company.
